model.name: Ames Multi-Model Stacking Regressor
model.architecture: Pipeline(AmesFeatureEngineer -> ColumnTransformer[RobustScaler, OneHotEncoder] -> StackingRegressor[7 Base Models -> Ridge(alpha=10.0)])

dataset.name: Ames Housing Dataset (Kaggle House Prices: Advanced Regression Techniques)
dataset.outlierFilterRule: Remove rows where GrLivArea > 4000 sq ft AND SalePrice < $300,000 (Dean De Cock documentation recommendation)

surfaceAxes.name: GrLivArea
surfaceAxes.label: Above-Grade Living Area
surfaceAxes.selectionRationale: Primary continuous spatial feature in the Ames dataset (Pearson r = 0.72 with log1p(SalePrice) after outlier sanitization; spans 334 to 4,476 sq ft).

surfaceAxes.name: OverallQual
surfaceAxes.label: Overall Material & Finish Quality
surfaceAxes.selectionRationale: Strongest single predictor of log1p(SalePrice) (Pearson r = 0.82), rating overall material and finish quality on an ordinal scale from 1 (Very Poor) to 10 (Very Excellent).

surface.matrixIndexingConvention: zMatrixUsd[row_idx][col_idx] corresponds to y = yAxis.values[row_idx] (OverallQual) and x = xAxis.values[col_idx] (GrLivArea).
surface.threeJsGeometryMapping: For a Three.js PlaneGeometry(width, depth, 49, 49), vertex index k = row_idx * 50 + col_idx maps directly to x = xAxis.values[col_idx], y_world (elevation) = zMatrixUsd[row_idx][col_idx], and z_world = yAxis.values[row_idx].

examples.label: Starter Budget Home (10th Percentile Price)
examples.selectionReason: Representative entry-level Ames residential property near the 10th percentile of SalePrice.

examples.label: Typical Median Ames Home (50th Percentile)
examples.selectionReason: Archetypal mid-market home near the dataset median SalePrice ($163k), GrLivArea, and OverallQual (6).

examples.label: Upper-Mid Family Home (75th Percentile Price)
examples.selectionReason: Representative 2-story family home at the 75th percentile of SalePrice with OverallQual=7.

examples.label: Executive High-Quality Home (90th Percentile Price)
examples.selectionReason: High-grade property at the 90th percentile of SalePrice with OverallQual=8.

examples.label: Luxury Custom Estate (99th Percentile Price)
examples.selectionReason: Top-tier luxury home with OverallQual>=9 and expansive living space.

examples.label: Compact High-Grade Home (Small Area, High Quality)
examples.selectionReason: Off-diagonal surface corner case: compact living area combined with high material quality (OverallQual>=7).

examples.label: Spacious Modest-Grade Home (Large Area, Average Quality)
examples.selectionReason: Off-diagonal surface corner case: large square footage (>2,200 sq ft) with modest finish quality (OverallQual<=5).

examples.label: Historic Remodeled Residence (Pre-1930 Build, Modern Remodel)
examples.selectionReason: Demonstrates temporal feature engineering (HouseAge vs RemodAge and IsRemodeled).

examples.label: Median Held-Out Error Benchmark Observation
examples.selectionReason: Observation whose held-out out-of-fold prediction error matches the dataset median absolute error.

examples.label: High Held-Out Residual Diagnostic Case (95th Percentile Error)
examples.selectionReason: Included for honest error analysis: held-out observation at the 95th percentile of absolute prediction error.

evaluation.methodology: 5-Fold Cross-Validation Out-of-Fold (OOF) Evaluation (`KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)`). Every observation's prediction `predictedOofUsd` is generated strictly by a StackingRegressor trained on the other 4 folds, preventing any training-set data leakage.

metricDefinitions.rmsle: Root Mean Squared Logarithmic Error: sqrt(mean((log1p(actualUsd) - log1p(predictedOofUsd))^2)).
metricDefinitions.maeUsd: Mean Absolute Error in USD on held-out out-of-fold predictions: mean(|actualUsd - predictedOofUsd|).
metricDefinitions.rmseUsd: Root Mean Squared Error in USD on held-out out-of-fold predictions: sqrt(mean((actualUsd - predictedOofUsd)^2)).
metricDefinitions.medianAeUsd: Median Absolute Error in USD on held-out out-of-fold predictions.
metricDefinitions.mapePct: Mean Absolute Percentage Error (%) on held-out out-of-fold predictions.
metricDefinitions.r2Usd: Coefficient of determination (R^2) in inverted USD price space on held-out OOF predictions.
metricDefinitions.r2Log1p: Coefficient of determination (R^2) in log1p(SalePrice) space on held-out OOF predictions.
